packages.label: הִרְהוּרֵי נִאוּף וְאֲבִי אָבוֹת הַטֻּמְאָה
packages.reason: These three nodes are different names for the same domain of spiritual death through sexual impurity. In Halacha, a corpse (מֵת) is called 'אֲבִי אָבוֹת הַטֻּמְאָה' — the ultimate source of impurity, the first degree from which all other impurity flows. The Rebbe equates lecherous thoughts (הִרְהוּרִים שֶׁל נִאוּף) with this same halakhic category, meaning they carry the same spiritual weight as a corpse. All three concepts are expressions of one and the same domain: the maximum degree of spiritual death and ritual impurity in the domain of sexual sin. They are not cause-and-effect but parallel faces of the same evil reality.
